[D26:11] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two dogs running in a field with a ball in their mouth

[D26:13] Audrey: Thanks! They're all mutts, but Pepper and Panda are Lab mixes, and Precious and Pixie are Chihuahua mixes. I really need that. I can't wait the day they're all back to normal.

[D1:1] Audrey: Hey Andrew! Good to see ya! What's been up since we last talked?

[D1:3] Audrey: Congrats on the new job! So I got these new collars and tags for my dogs - so cute!
[D1:4] Andrew: Thanks! That sounds cute. Can I see a picture?
[D1:5] Audrey: Sure! See them with their new collars, cute right?
[D1:5] Image caption (automatic): a photography of two dogs are standing in the grass with their mouths open
[D1:6] Andrew: Cute little guys! What are their names and how long have you had them?
[D1:7] Audrey: I've had them for 3 years! Their names are Pepper, Precious and Panda. I can't live without my little ones!
[D1:8] Andrew: That's awesome! Have you always wanted a dog, even with living in the city? Can they still go on adventures?
[D1:9] Audrey: Absolutely! They're city dogs and we explore all the time. They love trying out new parks and trails. We go on adventures together very often.
[D1:10] Andrew: Wow, sounds like they make life so awesome! Kinda jealous of all those fun outings with them.
[D1:11] Audrey: They really do! It's great how much happiness they bring. Do you have any pets?
[D1:12] Andrew: No, no pets right now. But I do love animals.
[D1:13] Audrey: That's great to hear! Animals are truly amazing. Do you have a favorite animal?
[D1:14] Andrew: I've always been awed by birds. Their power to soar and explore new spots is amazing.
[D1:15] Audrey: Yeah, birds are amazing! I can imagine it feels incredible to soar and see the world from up high. Do you have a favorite type of bird?
[D1:16] Andrew: Eagles have always mesmerized me; they're so strong and graceful!
[D1:16] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two birds flying in the sky with a sun shining behind them
[D1:17] Audrey: Yeah they're beautiful. Do you go bird-watching? It must be awesome to see them up close.
[D1:18] Andrew: Haven't specifically gone out for bird-watching, but I do spot them when I hike.
[D1:19] Audrey: Nice, spotting pretty birds while hiking must be great. Do you have any favorite hiking spots?
[D1:20] Andrew: Fox Hollow is a great trail to hike on weekends; the views are awesome!
[D1:21] Audrey: Cool, gonna give it a try. Thanks for the suggestion!
[D1:22] Andrew: No problem! Let me know how you like it. Have fun hiking!
[D1:23] Audrey: Thanks! I'll let you know. Have a good one!
[D1:24] Andrew: Take care and have a good one! See ya!

[D21:10] Audrey: Of course! If you need help or advice, just let me know. Plants can make your home so peaceful.
[D21:11] Andrew: Thanks! I'll definitely reach out if I need any help or advice. Thanks again for offering!
[D21:12] Audrey: No problem at all! Glad to be of assistance.
[D21:13] Andrew: Oh you've helped so much. 
[D21:14] Audrey: Haha i'm just doing what I can do to help.
[D21:15] Andrew: Thank you really. Well, take care and say hi to your dogs for me.
[D21:16] Audrey: Haha I will. Take care. Talk later!
[D21:17] Andrew: Yup, have a great week. 
[D21:18] Audrey: Have a great week! Bye!
Session date: 9:41 pm on 6 October, 2023
[D22:1] Audrey: Hey Andrew, I was thinking about what you said about missing nature the other day. It reminded me of when I couldn't walk my dogs because of a knee injury. It was tough 'cause they bring me so much joy. This pic was taken after I started walking again. It felt great to be able to get back out there!
[D22:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of two dogs running in a field with a ball in their mouth
[D22:2] Andrew: You know how it feel right? Bummer not being able to take them for a stroll. They must've been over the moon when you could finally take them out again. Glad you got that adorable pic too! Dogs are awesome like that, huh? Remind us to stop and smell the roses.
[D22:3] Audrey: Yeah, it was like they couldn't wait! They definitely reminds us to appreciate life's little pleasures. They see the world so differently!
[D22:4] Andrew: Yeah, dogs sure know how to find the simple joys of life! Appreciating the little things is so important. Well speaking of interesting hobbies, I rememver you mentionoed about that jewelry earlier? I remember you saying you make them with recycled objects. That sounds cool - tell me more!
[D22:5] Audrey: Oh yes! I love making jewelry out of recycled stuff. It's a great way to show my love of creativity and sustainability. I hunt down things like bottle caps, buttons, and broken jewelry, and then turn them into one-of-a-kind pieces. Here's a photo of one of my favorite necklaces. They all hold a special story and have their own appeal. Plus, it's a small step in reducing waste.
[D22:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman with a colorful necklace and earrings
[D22:6] Andrew: That necklace looks awesome! The colors really stand out and the design is really cool. It's great that you're giving recycled objects new life. Do you make jewelry to sell or just as a hobby? Also, do you donate profits to a good cause?
[D22:7] Audrey: Thanks! I started making jewelry as a hobby and then started selling it. I donate a portion of my profits to a cause that's close to my heart. Session date: 9:02 am on 22 November, 2023
[D28:1] Audrey: Hey Andrew! Long time no talk! Last Friday I took my fur kids to the pet salon - they were so psyched and their tails were wagging like crazy! It took a while for them to calm down, but all cut up they looked so cute! 
[D28:2] Andrew: Hey Audrey! Nice to hear from you. Sounds adorable! Do you have any pictures of them all groomed up?
[D28:3] Audrey: Here's a pic of them, looking all groomed. Look at those shiny coats! To top it off, they were really good at the salon - I always worry about them in new places.
[D28:3] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a dog is standing on a table with a leash
[D28:4] Andrew: Wow, they look great! Love seeing them happy and calm in new places.
[D28:5] Audrey: Thanks! It means a lot to see them happy and settled in new places. I guess I'm doing a good job as a doggy mom then, haha! Have you taken your furry friends to the groomers yet?
[D28:6] Andrew: No, we haven't got the chance to take them to the groomer yet. But will do that soon! So guess what, I can't help myself but to adpot another dog the other day. Here's a photo of the doggo!
[D28:6] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a woman feeding a dog hay in a barn
[D28:7] Audrey: That's great news! What's the pups name?
[D28:8] Andrew: It took us a while to decide, but we ended up going with 'Scout' for our pup - it seemed perfect for their adventurous spirit.
[D28:9] Audrey: That's a great name for your pup! Fits their adventurous spirit. What's Scout's first adventure gonna be?
[D28:10] Andrew: Thanks! We're gonna take Scout, Toby, and Buddy to a nearby park. It's not big, but we can all have fun and get some fresh air!
[D28:11] Audrey: Sounds like a great start for Scout! Start small, and gradually give them more exposure. They'll have a great time, just make sure to keep them leashed.
[D28:11] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a dog running with a tennis ball in its mouth
[D28:12] Andrew: Yeah, safety first! For now, we're keeping the new addition on a leash while they get used to being outside. That pic you of your dog at the park is so cute. So we got some essentials for their comfort and entertainment, like a bed, toys, and some puppy pads just in case. It's like their own little safe haven.
[D28:13] Audrey: Wow, that's so great that you two are creating a safe and fun space for Scout. It's really important they have a place that makes them feel secure. Slowly introduce Scout to Toby and Buddy, it takes time for the pups to get used to each other too! Scout is so lucky to have you and your girlfriend! 
[D28:14] Andrew: Thanks! We feel so lucky to have Scout. It's been amazing having so many furry friends! How are your dogs doing now? 
[D28:15] Audrey: They're doing great! Exploring, meeting new people...they feel so loved and safe. I'm really glad they're part of my life!
[D28:16] Andrew: That's great to hear! Dogs truly bring so much joy and friendship. I'm glad they're happy with you.
[D28:17] Audrey: Thanks! They're really awesome and bring so much joy and friendship. I'm so grateful to have them in my life as a part of my family.
[D28:18] Andrew: Yeah, it's great! Dogs are always there for us. We should count ourselves lucky to have such amazing furry friends as family member.
